info.source_content: The desk lamp dims after five idle minutes when battery powered. During a software update it stays bright. The default brightness for visitors remains undecided.
info.target_content: The garden sensor samples each hour while solar power is available. On a rainy day it waits until noon. The winter interval has yet to be agreed.
